title: Conversation about Computer Calligraphy (Vol. I) — सुरभि / Surabhi (Doordarshan)
license: Cinema Vision India — all rights reserved (as found)
notes: Surabhi feature on Prof. R. K. Joshi (IDC, IIT Bombay) and computer-generated Devanagari, U-matic hi-band master, 26.04.1991, English. Windows 1-2 modular grid letterforms and a drawn SHRI held on a green rostrum, 3-4 a hand lettering with a brush pen beside a font-editor CRT, 5-6 Joshi in interview (5 is the long window). The tape's first eight minutes and its off-tube screen sequence carry NO audio; every window here is taken from the parts that do. Cut from the spans fetched over ncaa.gov.in's iOS HLS path (iPhone User-Agent required); un-fetched spans are black filler so the timeline - and srcWindows - match the original tape.
